reason: Resolves a ref to the locator string it stands for with `locator.normalize()`, and reads the owning document through `ownerDocument`; Strider has no normalize, and a ref's frame isn't readable from the snapshot
Playwright's AI mode drops a generic wrapper from its output but keeps the ref of the element inside it; Strider's tree has no roleless nodes, so no node it omits has a ref to resolve
Checks that a data: URL in a link is truncated in the snapshot's `/url` line; Strider's snapshot node carries no link URL, and no matrix row names that field

Playwright's AI snapshot lists the visible content of an aria-hidden subtree and marks its top element `[aria-hidden]`; Strider's default snapshot leaves an aria-hidden subtree out and its node has no such state
